manuscript_status: AI-authored, unrefereed; fresh independent audit pending.
accepted_by_author: The full symplectomorphism group modulo Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms splits as the cohomology-module semidirect mapping-class group, using the existing extended-flux theorem.
Every presentation relator can simultaneously be made Hamiltonian by changing generator lifts.
Exact identity-monodromy stabilization-cost formula and finite stabilization.
Free-factor monodromy flatness and pullback equivalence over a surface times a circle.
A literal genus-one counterexample is a formulation boundary, not a solution of the intended hyperbolic-fiber question.
remaining: Whether arbitrary closed oriented genus-at-least-two surface bundles over surfaces or three-manifolds admit unrestricted smooth flat connections.
Whether arbitrary prescribed surface-group monodromy lifts to the area-preserving group without adding base handles.
Whether a useful Hofer lower bound can be proved over the full Hamiltonian-defect set.
